design_decision.chosen: (c) resolver layer, MATERIALIZED as an on-disk $ref-shim tree so (a)'s literal-path property also holds. Explicitly NOT (b).
design_decision.why_not_a_alone: 234 independently authored schemas means a second receipt.schema.json with its own copy of the constraints - the duplicate-control-plane defect the spec forbids - and at achievable fidelity they would be permissive stubs. A schema that accepts everything is worse than none.
design_decision.why_not_b: Rewriting output_schema across 2007 units edits a COMMITTED Wave-1 artifact that ~20 concurrent agents share one git index over, collapses 234 semantically distinct class names onto one physical file (destroying all cross-class discrimination), and burns the catalog provenance.
design_decision.why_not_pure_c: A code-only resolver leaves os.path.isfile(output_schema) False for all 234, so the stated defect is not actually closed for a naive consumer.
design_decision.how_duplication_is_avoided: Every generated file is pure delegation: its body is a $ref. A shim DEFINES no constraint. A class is receipt.schema.json#/$defs/generic_report (which already carries receipt_core plus the kind/observations/control_ids discipline) narrowed by ONE const pin on report.kind. Enforced by test_shims_carry_no_constraints, which fails if any shim grows a keyword outside a fixed allowlist.
design_decision.honest_cost: A declaration carrying a ' profile=...' or ' (required: ...)' annotation is still not a literal path; a consumer must split it first. The repo already owned that splitter (receipt_schema_gate.parse_schema_ref) and the resolver imports it rather than reimplementing it.

post_fix_counts.resolution_definition: the DECLARED path exists on disk AND its physical target exists AND a validator compiles from it. Path existence alone was rejected as insufficient.

residual_defects_found_but_NOT_fixed.P2_declared_field_names_are_forbidden_by: 118 references declare '(required: unit_id, artifact_paths[], spec_anchor, evidence[], test_ids[], negative_control_ids[], reviewer_verdict, residual_unknowns[])'. The physical receipt_core defines artifacts / tests / negative_controls / reviewer and sets additionalProperties:false, so a receipt authored to the DECLARED contract is REJECTED. Demonstrated deliberately as WFA-0129's malformed case. NOT fixed: the two available fixes are editing the catalog (rejected, option b) or adding aliases to receipt_core (weakens the schema). OWNER DECISION.
residual_defects_found_but_NOT_fixed.P3_546_references_get_no_cross_class_dis: 546 of 2007 references resolve to the canonical receipt, which is deliberately NOT kind-pinned. 118 of those carry a profile= annotation that could pin it, but receipt.schema.json's own comment on receipt_core.properties.profile states the 30 profile variants 'all declare the same required core, so a profile narrows nothing structurally and is carried for routing only'. Pinning it would invent a contract the source says does not exist. These 546 still get full receipt_core discipline plus the 12-condition predicate; they do not get cross-class discrimination. Breakdown: 1438 kind-pinned + 546 unpinned + 23 meta-schema = 2007.
residual_defects_found_but_NOT_fixed.P3_two_catalog_paths_name_the_same_meta_: command-center/schema/_meta/json-schema-2020-12.json and command-center/schema/meta/json-schema-draft.json. Resolved by storing the document once and making the second an alias, but the catalog duplication itself remains.

residual_unknowns.independent_review: NOT-CHECKED. No independent cross-vendor reviewer has audited this substrate. Settled by dispatching a fresh-context Codex refuter over artifact-class-profiles.schema.json and schema_resolver.py.
residual_unknowns.downstream_adoption: NOT-CHECKED. Nothing yet rewires existing emitters/harvesters to call schema_resolver.validator_for(). The substrate makes a schema-valid receipt POSSIBLE for all 2007 units; it does not prove any other component has been pointed at it. Settled by grepping for open()/json.load() on an output_schema value and converting each call site.
residual_unknowns.class_payload_fidelity: PARTIAL. A class pins report.kind and inherits the observations/control_ids discipline; it does not model class-specific payload fields (a research-claim-record and an audit-finding differ by name and kind, not yet by field set). Settled by mining each class's evidence_requirement text into per-class report properties - a follow-on unit.
